name: EOSDice
rootCause: The well-known DApp EOSDice was hacked again due to random number issues. The attacker was a hacker who previously attacked EOSDice and FFGame DApp. The project side wrongly add a controlled seed in random algorithm which lead the attack.

descriptions.text: The well-known DApp EOSDice was hacked again due to random number issues. The attacker was a hacker who previously attacked EOSDice and FFGame DApp. The project side wrongly add a controlled seed in random algorithm which lead the attack.
Random number was cracked by attacker.

EOSDice, a gambling dApp on the EOS blockchain, was exploited twice in November 2018 due to predictable pseudo-random number generation. Attackers manipulated refer block data and contract balances to predetermine game outcomes, extracting an estimated $25,100 in EOS. No on-chain transaction or contract source for the exploit is publicly verified. EOSDice's random number function relied on blockchain values and contract balances that were controllable or predictable by attackers. Deferred execution and EOS notification order allowed adversaries to coordinate betting, notification, and balance manipulation so random outcomes could be calculated or guaranteed before placing bets.
